name: set_target_level
description: Set the learner's target level (learner.target_level: where the village's ages lead, each age a share of its words; companion/GAME.md "Ages"). A raise starts with the village's next age (learner.target_level_next): the step the village is on keeps its words, the new target counts from the next age on, and the bridge applies it when the village gets there. A lower target, or the current one again (which takes a waiting raise back), applies at once. Only when the learner or their parent asks. Answers what changed and what the step now and the next one need.

level.description: The CEFR level to aim at: A1, A2, B1, B2, C1 or C2
